name: shipdeck
description: ADF-style visual DevOps delivery platform — source to target with CI/CD and infra

scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @shipdeck/shared && npm run dev -w @shipdeck/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @shipdeck/shared && npm run build -w @shipdeck/api && npm run build -w @shipdeck/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @shipdeck/shared && npm run test -w @shipdeck/api
